The Process

Simple. Fast. Spotless.

From booking to a sparkling-clean bin — here's exactly what to expect.

01

Book Online Instantly

Pick your date and time window on our live calendar. Windows run 7am–10am and 10am–1pm (Thu & Fri also 1pm–4pm; Sat & Sun 9am–2pm). Confirmed immediately by email & text.

02

We Arrive at Your Home

Our team shows up during your window and connects to your outdoor water spigot — no hassle on your end whatsoever. You don't even need to be home.

03

Sanitized & Done

We pressure-wash, sanitize, and deodorize using eco-friendly products. Left sparkling clean and odor-free — ready for the next collection day.

Heads up: Please have your bins emptied before service. Bins that aren't emptied incur a $10 fee per visit. We book in time windows, not exact arrival times, and will reach out if anything needs adjusting.
